papers.title: Multilevel Quasi-Monte Carlo Methods for Lognormal Diffusion Problems
papers.abstract: In this paper we present a rigorous cost and error analysis of a multilevel estimator based on randomly shifted Quasi-Monte Carlo (QMC) lattice rules for lognormal diffusion problems. These problems are motivated by uncertainty quantification problems in subsurface flow. We extend the convergence analysis in [Graham et al., Numer. Math. 2014] to multilevel Quasi-Monte Carlo finite element discretizations and give a constructive proof of the dimension-independent convergence of the QMC rules. More precisely, we provide suitable parameters for the construction of such rules that yield the required variance reduction for the multilevel scheme to achieve an $\varepsilon$-error with a cost of $\mathcal{O}(\varepsilon^{-θ})$ with $θ< 2$, and in practice even $θ\approx 1$, for sufficiently fast decaying covariance kernels of the underlying Gaussian random field inputs. This confirms that the computational gains due to the application of multilevel sampling methods and the gains due to the application of QMC methods, both demonstrated in earlier works for the same model problem, are complementary. A series of numerical experiments confirms these gains. The results show that in practice the multilevel QMC method consistently outperforms both the multilevel MC method and the single-level variants even for non-smooth problems.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学有限元不确定性量化，但论文本身不涉及植入物设计或生物医学应用。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is purely methodological on a subsurface flow PDE and does not involve implant mechanics, structural FEA, or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高对数正态扩散问题不确定性量化的计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出多层级准蒙特卡洛（MLQMC）结合有限元离散，并给出构造参数。
summary_zh.result: MLQMC方法优于多层级MC和单层QMC，成本达到O(ε^{-θ})，θ<2。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证收敛性和计算增益。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of uncertainty quantification for lognormal diffusion problems arising in subsurface flow.
summary_en.method: A multilevel estimator based on randomly shifted Quasi-Monte Carlo lattice rules is combined with finite element discretization, with constructive parameters for variance reduction.
summary_en.result: The multilevel QMC method achieves an ε-error with cost O(ε^{-θ}) where θ<2, outperforming multilevel MC and single-level QMC even for non-smooth problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical convergence rates and demonstrate practical computational gains.

papers.title: Muscular strength after total hip arthroplasty
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND PURPOSE: Minimizing the decrease in muscular strength after total hip arthroplasty (THA) might allow patients to recover faster. We evaluated muscular strength in patients who were operated on using 3 surgical approaches. PATIENTS AND METHODs: In a prospective cohort study, 60 patients scheduled for primary THA were allocated to the direct lateral, posterior, or anterior approach. Leg press and abduction strength were evaluated 2 weeks or less preoperatively, 2 and 8 days postoperatively, and at 6-week and 3-month follow-up. RESULTS: Differences in maximal strength change were greatest after 2 and 8 days. The posterior and anterior approaches produced less decrease in muscular strength than the direct lateral approach. 6 weeks postoperatively, the posterior approach produced greater increase in muscular strength than the direct lateral approach, and resulted in a greater increase in abduction strength than the anterior approach. At 3-month follow-up, no statistically significant differences between the groups were found. The operated legs were 18% weaker in leg press and 15% weaker in abduction than the unoperated legs, and the results were similar between groups. INTERPRETATION: The posterior and anterior approaches appeared to have the least negative effect on abduction and leg press muscular strength in the first postoperative week; the posterior approach had the least negative effect, even up to 6 weeks postoperatively. THA patients have reduced muscle strength in the operated leg (compared to the unoperated leg) 3 months after surgery.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估不同手术入路对全髋关节置换后肌力的影响
summary_zh.method: 前瞻性队列研究，比较直接外侧、后侧和前侧入路的肌力变化
summary_zh.result: 后侧和前侧入路早期肌力下降较少，后侧入路6周时恢复更好

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the effect of different surgical approaches on postoperative muscular strength after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A prospective cohort study comparing leg press and abduction strength before and after direct lateral, posterior, and anterior approaches.
summary_en.result: The posterior and anterior approaches resulted in less strength loss initially, and the posterior approach led to greater recovery at 6 weeks postoperatively.
summary_en.validation: Clinical measurements from 60 patients at multiple time points.

corresponding_authors.name: Ifeoma A. Inneh
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, NYU Langone Medical Center, Hospital for Joint Diseases, New York, New York

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅调查全髋关节置换术后住院时间的临床因素，不涉及任何生物力学分析或植入物力学性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify proximal femur stress/strain, micromotion, contact mechanics, or any finite element analysis; it is a purely clinical outcomes study.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究人口统计学、合并症和术中因素对全髋关节置换术后住院时间的影响
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析患者数据，使用多变量回归模型识别独立预测因子
summary_zh.result: 发现年龄、合并症和手术时间等因素显著影响住院时间
summary_zh.validation: 基于大型临床数据库的统计分析

summary_en.motivation: To identify sociodemographic, comorbid, and intraoperative factors that predict length of stay after primary total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of patient records using multivariable regression to determine independent predictors of hospital stay duration.
summary_en.result: Patient age, comorbidity burden, and operative time were significant independent predictors of prolonged length of stay.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis of a large clinical database with multivariate modeling.
